name: Ancient Greek (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in ancient Greek offered by the Classics Department to non-majors. A certificate adviser, typically the DUS, advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on the student transcript once certified.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, one course such as an independent study (graded pass/fail), graduate seminar, or advanced seminar may count
One LxC course taught in English may count if it includes a weekly discussion section conducted entirely in Greek (minimum three students; course designated LxC)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Greek may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses in ancient Greek beyond the L4 level (i.e., four L5 courses; 3000- or 4000-level Greek courses).
